data.gender_notes: Zimrion is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Hebrew 'zamar' (to remember) and 'yonah' (dove). A name representing devotion and spirituality, inspired by the Old Testament's Zimri, a war captain who praised God fervently. The name Zimrion carries the meaning “Remembrance of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Zimrion usually hope their child will grow to embody remembrance of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of deep faith and reverence towards God.
data.etymology: Zimrion belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Remembrance of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zimrion total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Zimrion" has a unique and intriguing cultural impact due to its Hebrew origins. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'zamar,' which means 'to remember' or 'to sing praises,' and 'yonah,' which signifies 'dove.' This name reflects the rich cultural heritage of the Jewish people, who have long held singing and remembrance as integral aspects of their faith and traditions. The name may also resonate with those of other religious and cultural backgrounds who value the practice of devotion and commemoration.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Zimrion" holds substantial spiritual significance for Christians. It is inspired by the Old Testament figure Zimri, a mighty warrior who was noted for his fervent devotion to God. When faced with a daunting task, Zimri gave a resounding battle cry, praising God and uttering His name in a show of unwavering faith. This name embodies the idea of remembering God in all circumstances and expressing one's wholehearted commitment to Him in moments of challenge or triumph. The image of the dove, which is also encoded in Zimrion's name, is a symbol of the Holy Spirit and peace. Thus, the name "Zimrion" presents a potent reminder of the transformative power of faith and the importance of maintaining a spiritual connection with God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Zimrion is derived from the Hebrew word "zimrah," meaning "song of praise." This name symbolizes a deep connection to God, with the one bearing this name offering constant praise and worship through music and prayer. It is a reminder to always keep the spirit of gratitude and joy in one's heart.

historical_references.reference: According to the Book of Jasher, King Zimrion of Elam was the king who led the Elamite forces against Joshua and the Israelites during the conquest of the land of Canaan. This event is described in Joshua 9:1-27 and is believed to have occurred around 1200 BCE.

historical_references.reference: In the Middle Ages, Saint Zimrion, also known as Zimri or Zimrith, was a legendary bishop of Cyprus. According to hagiographical texts, he was a hermit who lived in a cave near the city of Solon, where he was visited by Saint Lazarus of Bethany. After being ordained as a bishop, Zimrion is said to have performed numerous miracles and built several churches on Cyprus. His life is believed to have taken place in the late 4th or early 5th century CE.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Zimrion, derived from the biblical character Zimri, is seen in various modern contexts.
